mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let's take a moment to remember that the path toward antiracism isn’t a straight shot. It twists and turns—with challenges, setbacks, and real moments of hope and transformation along the way. Maybe you’re wondering where to start, or how to keep going when things get tough. Here’s what I want you to hold onto: Every single choice you make, no matter how small, shapes the world around you. Policies matter just as much as what we believe—so let’s push for both to change. Self-interest? That’s normal. But solidarity? That’s a choice you get to make, every day. Healing and justice—they go hand in hand, and neither can be rushed or forced. And vision? It’s your compass. Imagine the world you want, then take steps to create it. The truth is, you don’t have to be perfect to make a difference. This work isn’t about never messing up—it’s about being open to learning, listening, and trying again. There’ll be days when it feels overwhelming, when progress seems painfully slow, or when old habits are stubborn. In those moments, just remember—you’re never walking this path alone. Others have been here before you, and others will follow after. Change is real, not because the world is simple, but because people are capable of growing. Every act of courage, every honest conversation, every policy shifted—these are the steps that move us closer to a community where everyone truly belongs. So, keep moving forward, one step at a time. The work is worth it. And so are you.
